summary: Source-reviewed rework repaired the Table 1 activity layer and database reconciliation for Pa-MAP 1.9. The paper is acceptable with cautions: primary Table 1 values are supported, DBAASP assay rows are matched, CAMP/dbAMP entry-level anticancer labels remain source-conflict, and mechanism claims are bounded to direct leakage/AFM plus supporting biophysical context.
adjudication_summary: Worker-6 compared packet XML/PDF/supplement/database rows with repaired worker-2 and worker-4 artifacts; rwk-complete-test-0001 is resolved if strict gates pass.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/PMC OA package, S1 PDF text, Nature landing HTML bins, and linked database JSONL rows were opened. No local supplement changed Table 1 values.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/literature rows are source-supported by Table 1 and article metadata; CAMP/dbAMP entry-level activity labels are retained as source_conflict where they overstate anticancer/mammalian-cell support.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary XML/PDF Table 1 yields 13 source-located rows: 9 MIC, 2 MBIC, 1 cytotoxicity threshold, and 1 hemolysis threshold; no database-only row is promoted as a primary assay.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Direct mechanism evidence is limited to LUV leakage and AFM surface perturbation; CD/docking/dynamics are supporting context only, and biofilm inhibition remains an activity phenotype.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_final: The prior framework-only review defect is repaired; open rework targets are cleared only after strict gate evidence is produced.

caution_findings.evidence_context: CAMP/dbAMP entry-level rows include anticancer/mammalian-cell labels broader than the primary paper; preserved as source_conflict in database audit.
Primary Table 1/results/database rows support >115 μM for hemolysis; local methods text appears to carry an mM/mL typo and was not used to alter the table row.
Local XML/HTML records a correction-forward link, but no local correction text changing Table 1 or database evidence was present in the packet.
Mechanism figure curves are described qualitatively unless exact values are stated in text/table.

gate_expectation: semantic and publication gates should pass after ticket resolution because activity rows are present and final review has no open rework targets.
